objective: Diagnose every behavioral defect in the deliberately broken risk-ledger validator fixture.
deliverable: A concise defect report naming each defective behavior and the smallest correction.
The predicted result for each declared probe before and after correction.

success.measure: Declared probes predicted correctly before and after correction

evidence: Citations to the exact fixture expressions causing each defect
A before/after table for probes P1 through P3
guardrails: Read only; do not edit the fixture or repository.
Report behavioral defects only, not stylistic preferences.
Do not inspect the compiler source or any expected-answer file.

may_decide: How to inspect and explain the fixture
producer_owned: Whether any correction will later be implemented

completion: Stop after all three success criteria have evidence or a blocker is named.
